title: Company Outcome Backbone: Initiative Taxonomy, Escalation Windows, and Commitment API
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem statement: As the company scales, initiative naming, ownership, and escalation conventions have fractured across teams. This makes company-level OKR tracking brittle: initiatives drift, responsibility is unclear during blocked work, and prioritization signals are noisy.

Goal: Build an "Outcome Backbone" consisting of a) a standardized initiative taxonomy and ownership contract, b) documented escalation windows with SLAs for cross-team blockers, and c) a lightweight Commitment API (read/write) that product, engineering, and design tooling can use to register, query, and resolve initiative states. The deliverable will include a confluence PRD, a short API spec, a migration plan for existing initiatives, and an adoption playbook for leadership.

Success metrics: 1) Reduce cross-team initiative ambiguity incidents (as reported in post-mortems and enablement surveys) by 60% within two quarters; 2) 80% of new company initiatives created via the Commitment API within the first release cycle; 3) Average blocker resolution time for cross-functional dependencies falls from current baseline to under 5 business days for high-impact blockers.

Out of scope: Full integration with all downstream tooling (we will prioritize Console and Linear first). Deep workflow automation (e.g., auto-escalations into PagerDuty) is deferred to a follow-up.

Why now: Recent company OKR syncs flagged repeated missed handoffs and unclear ownership alongside faster team formation in Dedicated and Private product workstreams. A lightweight canonical layer will enable better rollups, automated rollout guardrails, and less firefighting during quarter transitions.
acceptance_criteria: Confluence PRD published and approved by PM lead and Head of Eng
Initiative taxonomy defined with at least 5 stable categories and example mappings
Commitment API spec (openAPI-like) with 3 endpoints: createInitiative, updateOwnership, queryStatus
Migration guide and script that maps 80% of active initiatives into the taxonomy without manual edits
Escalation windows documented (normal / expedited) with RACI and SLA thresholds
Pilot integration completed with Linear: new initiatives created via API appear with taxonomy tags and ownership fields
Stakeholder sign-off recorded from Product, Eng, Design, and GTM leads

next_steps: Finalize taxonomy and PRD comments by 2026-03-29; finalize API spec and security review checklist by 2026-04-07; schedule a 1-week pilot with Console and Linear engineering teams for 2026-04-15 to 2026-04-22.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Low adoption if API requires heavy manual tagging. Mitigation: Partner with Growth to create onboarding templates and include taxonomy suggestions in PR flow. Risk: Misaligned SLAs across Eng teams. Mitigation: Run a 2-week SLA calibration exercise with Eng leads and incorporate exceptions into the escalation doc.
